Description: I produce fountain pens for artists and sell them online through our Shopify website, Amazon, and other suitable online venues. We don't do any wholesale. I spend most of my time updating online listings and the usual clerical work involved with running a small business. I reconfigure pens sometimes, then ship them using a medium USPS box that I take to the post office.
